summary_en: ¥35/share interim dividend (¥30 ordinary + ¥5 commemorative) on 2026-06-30 base date; ¥1,718M total payout; effective 2026-09-02. Commemorates company name change to Daiwa Industries on 2026-07-01. FY2026 annual dividend guidance raised to ¥65/share (from ¥60/share prior guidance) combining interim and year-end payments.
title_en: Notice regarding Dividend from Retained Earnings (Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-08, the board of Daiwa Industries resolved to pay an interim dividend of ¥35 per share with a record date of 2026-06-30, effective 2026-09-02. The dividend comprises ¥30 ordinary and ¥5 commemorative components, totaling ¥1,718M in aggregate payout. The commemorative portion marks the company's name change to Daiwa Industries (from Daiwa Refrigeration Industries), completed on 2026-07-01, as part of shareholder return policy. The company's full-year FY2026 dividend guidance has been raised to ¥65 per share (combining the interim ¥35 and year-end ¥30 dividend), from the prior guidance of ¥60 per share issued on 2026-02-10. The prior period (FY2025 12-month) paid ¥50 per share in total.
